description: Calibration against v2_ifx_mock_api_rewrite (same app fixture, same mock-supersedes-origin semantics): real Playwright registers a route on **/v0_2/ifx/api-primary that fulfills with an injected JSON body, then triggers the page helper __abbApiField() which fetches that route and renders the parsed 'answer' field. The asserted value 'V3-MOCK-PW-K3F9' exists only in this task's injected body, never on the origin route (which serves a decoy), so a pass proves the framework's interception path (Fetch enable/fulfillRequest) actually rewired the response. Raw-CDP replay did the same via manual Fetch.requestPaused handling.
title: real Playwright route fulfill supersedes the origin API
